# noozle_amqp_0_9_outlet (Resource)

Manages a Noozle AMQP 0.9.1 outlet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

resource "noozle_amqp_0_9_outlet" "alerts" {
  name          = "AMQP 0.9.1 alerts"
  enabled       = true
  exchange      = "noozle.alerts"
  key           = "alerts.critical"
  notify_policy = "FIRST_ONLY"

  transform {
    selected = "summarize"
  }

  credentials {
    urls = [
      "amqps://alerts:replace-me@rabbitmq-a.example.com:5671/%2f",
    ]
    urls_version = 1
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the outlet is active.
- `exchange` (String) AMQP exchange name.
- `key` (String) AMQP routing key.
- `name` (String) Name presented for the outlet.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `app_id` (String) AMQP application ID interpolation.
- `content_encoding` (String) AMQP content encoding interpolation.
- `content_type` (String) AMQP content type interpolation.
- `correlation_id` (String) AMQP correlation ID interpolation.
- `credentials` (Block, Optional) Connection URLs for this outlet. The URLs are write-only; rotate them by updating the list and incrementing `urls_version`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--credentials))
- `description` (String) Optional note explaining the outlet purpose.
- `exchange_declare_durable` (Boolean) Declare the AMQP exchange as durable.
- `exchange_declare_enabled` (Boolean) Passively declare and verify the AMQP exchange.
- `exchange_declare_type` (String) AMQP exchange type to declare.
- `expiration` (String) AMQP per-message TTL interpolation.
- `immediate` (Boolean) Set the AMQP immediate flag.
- `mandatory` (Boolean) Set the AMQP mandatory flag.
- `max_in_flight` (Number) Maximum number of in-flight AMQP messages.
- `message_id` (String) AMQP message ID interpolation.
- `metadata_exclude_prefixes` (List of String) Metadata prefixes to exclude from AMQP headers.
- `mtls` (Block, Optional) Optional mutual TLS feature for the outlet. Conflicts with `tls`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--mtls))
- `notify_policy` (String) Delivery policy applied when notifying this outlet.
- `persistent` (Boolean) Publish AMQP messages as persistent.
- `priority` (String) AMQP priority interpolation.
- `reply_to` (String) AMQP reply-to interpolation.
- `timeout` (String) AMQP publish timeout.
- `tls` (Block, Optional) Optional TLS feature for the outlet. Conflicts with `mtls`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--tls))
- `tls_enable_renegotiation` (Boolean) Allow TLS renegotiation for AMQP connections.
- `tls_skip_cert_verify` (Boolean) Skip AMQP TLS certificate verification.
- `transform` (Attributes) Optional outlet transform selection and observed runtime state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--transform))
- `type` (String) AMQP message type interpolation.
- `user_id` (String) AMQP user ID interpolation.

### Read-Only

- `applied_generation` (Number) Last observed applied config generation.
- `apply_status` (String) Observed apply/runtime status for the outlet.
- `config_generation` (Number) Desired outlet config generation.
- `id` (Number) Unique identifier of the outlet.
- `last_apply_error` (String) Last observed apply/runtime error message.
